purpose: Test if changing object identifier allows unauthorized access to another user's private record.
expected_secure_behavior: Server returns HTTP 403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found verifying resource ownership.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server returns private profile and data of User 102.
remediation: Enforce object-level access control: verify resource.ownerId === req.user.id in database query.

purpose: Test mass assignment / parameter tampering vulnerability on user update endpoints.
expected_secure_behavior: Server ignores or rejects unexpected 'role' field, keeping role immutable.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server persists 'role: admin' to database, granting administrative privileges.
remediation: Use explicit field allowlists for request body updates (e.g., using lodash.pick or zod schema filtering).

purpose: Test whether administrative API routes enforce role verification middleware.
expected_secure_behavior: Server checks req.user.role === 'admin' and returns HTTP 403 Forbidden.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server allows any authenticated user to read administrative resources.
remediation: Apply requireRole('admin') middleware to all sensitive /api/admin/* route groups.

purpose: Verify whether unguessable UUIDs alone are relied upon without database-level ownership checks.
expected_secure_behavior: Server checks tenant or user ownership in query even when UUID is known.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server delivers file solely because UUID matched without verifying session ownership.
remediation: Never rely solely on UUID obscurity. Always query WHERE id = ? AND organization_id = ?.
